publish.message: Afterwards anyone on the internet can see every file, video and image of this learning room – including the people shown in videos, often children and young people. After unpublishing, the content stays visible in the website cache for a while. Check the material before you publish.

unpublish.message: Afterwards the learning room is visible to members only. On the website the content may stay visible in the cache for a while.
